highlights_headline: Hash-code seeds now use operating-system cryptographic randomness in both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp.
highlights_body: Hash codes remain randomized between processes and stable within a process. First use now initializes the cryptographic random-number generator.

bullets.detail: The shared HashCode implementation replaces System.Random with RandomNumberGenerator, avoiding clock-seeded randomness on .NET Framework. This adds cryptography initialization to the first hash-code operation without changing within-process stability.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Replaced the shared hash seed with cryptographic randomness and added analyzer checks for shipped code.
